description: Workpiece 2 semantic frame. Origin is the STL bounding-box centre (0, 0, 0). In the approved Top-view projection, +X is left, +Y is down, and +Z is toward the observer. For the positive/front tabletop pose, +X is along the workpiece forward direction, +Y is to its left, and +Z points outward toward the observer (above the table). The frame is right-handed.

positive_face.description: For tabletop placement, semantic +Z must have a positive dot product with the table-up normal. The workpiece may rotate in azimuth, but must not be flipped to the reverse face.
